newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Foschini bounces back after recent selling.
newsitem.headline: Foschini bounces back after recent selling.

text.p: Shares in South African clothing retailer Foschini Ltd bounced back on Wednesday as small-scale buyers snapped up the stock after a recent battering, dealers said.

As recently as May 5 the firm's share was trading as high as 17.60 rand, but the group took a severe knock after fellow clothing group Edgars Ltd reported a sharp drop in profits at the start of this month.
Foschini hit a recent year low of 13.40 rand, but had climbed to 14.00 rand by 0930 GMT, a gain of 50 cents on the day in light volume of just 5,600 shares.
"It had to start coming back eventually. The stock was far too oversold," one dealer said.
Holding firm Lewis Foschini Ltd was also on the recovery trail as it gained 60 cents to 450 cents, making it the fourth biggest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
